require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'
require 'fileutils'
require 'redis'

module ContainerOrch
  class RateLimiter
    WINDOW_SIZE = 60
    MAX_UPLOADS = 5

    def initialize(redis_client)
      @redis = redis_client
    end

    def check_rate_limit(client_id, resource_type)
      key = build_key(client_id, resource_type)
      current_count = @redis.get(key).to_i
      if current_count >= MAX_UPLOADS
        return false
      end
      increment_counter(key)
      true
    end

    private

    def build_key(client_id, resource_type)
      normalized_id = normalize_identifier(client_id)
      "rate:#{normalized_id}:#{resource_type}"
    end

    def normalize_identifier(raw_id)
      # Strip whitespace and downcase for consistency
      cleaned = raw_id.to_s.strip.downcase
      # Truncate to 64 chars to prevent key bloat
      cleaned[0, 64]
    end

    def increment_counter(key)
      @redis.multi do |tx|
        tx.incr(key)
        tx.expire(key, WINDOW_SIZE)
      end
    end
  end

  class UploadProcessor
    ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.tar .tar.gz .dockerfile .yaml .yml].freeze
    MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
    UPLOAD_DIR = '/var/uploads/containers'

    def initialize(rate_limiter)
      @rate_limiter = rate_limiter
    end

    def process_upload(request_env)
      client_id = extract_client_id(request_env)
      file_data = request_env['rack.input'].read
      filename = request_env['HTTP_X_FILENAME'] || 'upload.tar'
      content_type = detect_content_type(filename)

      unless validate_extension(filename)
        return [400, { error: 'Invalid file type' }.to_json]
      end

      unless validate_size(file_data)
        return [413, { error: 'File too large' }.to_json]
      end

      resource_type = classify_resource(filename, content_type)
      
      unless @rate_limiter.check_rate_limit(client_id, resource_type)
        return [429, { error: 'Rate limit exceeded' }.to_json]
      end

      store_result = store_upload(client_id, filename, file_data)
      [200, { status: 'accepted', id: store_result }.to_json]
    end

    private

    def extract_client_id(env)
      # Primary: API key header, fallback: session token
      api_key = env['HTTP_X_API_KEY']
      return derive_client_id(api_key) if api_key && !api_key.empty?
      
      session_token = env['HTTP_X_SESSION_TOKEN']
      return derive_client_id(session_token) if session_token && !session_token.empty?
      
      # Last resort: IP-based identification
      env['REMOTE_ADDR'] || '0.0.0.0'
    end

    def derive_client_id(credential)
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(credential.to_s)
    end

    def classify_resource(filename, content_type)
      'upload'
    end

    def detect_content_type(filename)
      ext = File.extname(filename).downcase
      case ext
      when '.tar' then 'application/x-tar'
      when '.gz'  then 'application/gzip'
      when '.yaml', '.yml' then 'text/yaml'
      else 'application/octet-stream'
      end
    end

    def validate_extension(filename)
      ext = File.extname(filename).downcase
      ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(ext) || filename.end_with?('.tar.gz')
    end

    def validate_size(data)
      data.bytesize <= MAX_FILE_SIZE
    end

    def store_upload(client_id, filename, data)
      safe_name = sanitize_filename(filename)
      upload_id = SecureRandom.hex(16)
      dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, client_id[0, 8], upload_id)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(dir)
      File.write(File.join(dir, safe_name), data, mode: 'wb')
      upload_id
    end

    def sanitize_filename(name)
      File.basename(name).gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, '_')
    end
  end

  class App < Sinatra::Base
    configure do
      redis = Redis.new(url: ENV['REDIS_URL'] || 'redis://localhost:6379/0')
      limiter = RateLimiter.new(redis)
      set :processor, UploadProcessor.new(limiter)
    end

    post '/api/v1/upload' do
      status_code, body = settings.processor.process_upload(request.env)
      status status_code
      content_type :json
      body
    end
  end
end
